_comment: KRONOS2 (MahmoodLab/KRONOS2 on HuggingFace) -- the authors' next-generation, marker-aware successor to KRONOS. Loaded via transformers.AutoModel (trust_remote_code). No local marker_metadata.csv/model_assets needed -- the model ships its own 288-marker vocabulary and does its own marker-aware z-score via model.preprocess(). name_mappings here alias our marker names onto that vocabulary, checked against the bundled marker_metadata.csv's exact-match logic (marker_utils.marker_match_key).

IMMUcan._comment_exclude_markers: DNA1/DNA2/HistoneH3 excluded for the same reason as every other method (nuclear/housekeeping stains, not phenotypic markers). CD33/Ecad/cleavedPARP additionally excluded: KRONOS2's marker-conditioning forward() (unlike its z-score preprocess() step) has no fallback for an unmatched marker -- it hard-fails with 'No (fuzzy) match found' against model.backbone.marker_builder for all three. KRONOS2 sees 34 markers here vs. KRONOS1's 37.
IMMUcan._comment_name_mappings: Checked against KRONOS2's bundled marker_metadata.csv (288 markers) and model.backbone.marker_builder's fuzzy matcher: SMA/GrzB/CD8a/TCF7/CD303/CarbonicAnhydrase have no match under their IMMUcan spelling but a biological-identity alias passes (A-SMA=SMA, GZMB=GrzB, CD8=CD8a, TCF1=TCF7, BDCA-2=CD303, CA9=CarbonicAnhydrase IX).

cHL_2_MIBI._comment_patch_size: Same 64px as IMMUcan -- see kronos.json's cHL comment for the measured cell-footprint justification.
cHL_2_MIBI._comment_exclude_markers: Histone H3/SLP-76/anti-H2AX (pS139)/dsDNA/pSLP-76: same 5 excluded for every method on cHL (housekeeping/nuclear, not phenotypic). CD153 (CD30L) additionally excluded: no row in the model's marker_metadata.csv (288 rows) matches CD153/CD30L/TNFSF8/'CD30 ligand' under any spelling. RORgT maps to the vocabulary entry 'RORGD' (marker_full_name: 'Retinoic acid-related orphan receptor gamma t') -- see name_mappings below. KRONOS2 sees 40 markers here.
cHL_2_MIBI._comment_name_mappings: Checked against model.backbone.marker_builder's fuzzy matcher: B2M, NAKATP, and RORGD all pass as exact vocabulary entries.
